name: Phantasmal Assailants
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will disbelief, then Fortitude partial, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a phantasmal image of nightmarish creatures surrounding the target. Only the spell’s target can see the phantasmal assailants. You see shadowy shapes, while others see nothing. The target first gets a Will save to recognize the image as unreal, at which point, on a success the spell fails. If the target fails their saving throw, the phantasms strike, dealing 8 points of Wisdom and Dexterity damage. A successful Fortitude save at this point halves the ability damage.

If the target of the phantasmal assailants succeeds in disbelieving and possesses telepathy or is wearing a helm of telepathy, the spell can be turned upon you.

You must then disbelieve it or become subject to its effects.
